estimand: Value captured by third-party searchers, and the builders they paid, because of the hacker swaps; 3,311-block window, 55-address scope.

sandwich_closed_groups_net_ETH.assumption: Closed same-sender front/back groups; EVM removal of the target breaks the exit leg in all 117 verified experiments; includes the one non-positive closed group.

backrun_intervention_ETH.assumption: Per transaction: actual minus target-removed cashflow, smallest across removed targets, clipped to [0, actual profit].

builder_payments_ETH.assumption: Priority fees of closed sandwich legs plus priority fees and direct fee-recipient transfers of back-runs that revert or lose money without the target.

lower_bound.excludes: Open-inventory sandwiches, unlinked cycles, other chains, and any payment not visible on the execution layer.

net_causal_effect_on_backrun_bots_ETH.meaning: Sum of signed differences. Negative cases are bots that would have earned more without the hacker swap (the hacker swap removed an existing price gap). They reduce other bots' income; they do not reduce what was extracted from the hacker, so they are not netted into the lower bound.

all_sandwich_groups_positive_ETH.assumption: Max of positive five-minute marked value of priced groups and positive closed ETH net. Unpriced groups are not valued.

all_single_tx_cycles_positive_ETH.assumption: Every closed single-transaction cycle in scope is treated as caused by the hacker, linked or not.

builder_payments_by_all_MEV_candidates_E.assumption: Priority fees and direct fee-recipient transfers of every MEV-candidate transaction in the window, all treated as hacker-caused.

upper_bound.not_covered: Unpriced sandwich groups and non-Ethereum venues.

hard_ceiling.meaning: Total strict execution shortfall of the 16 wallets. Ordering profit cannot exceed what the hacker lost against the reference price; most of this stayed with liquidity providers as price impact.

summary: MEV extracted around the hacker swaps lies between 312.725354 and 6687.938988 ETH (about USD 701734-15007267 at ETH = 2243.93). That is at most 28.30% of the USD 53031865 execution shortfall.
